title: D Block
desc: When the female students of an engineering college mysteriously disappear and are found dead, a young man and his friends decide to look for the culprit.

title: Antony
desc: Antony, a ruthless gangster, becomes a guardian to Ann Maria, the daughter of a local thug he killed. As they work on their relationship, a forgotten enemy returns to finish them off.

title: Coolie
desc: Zafar's obsessive love for Salma leads to her separation from her son, Iqbal. Twenty years later, Iqbal strives to reunite with his mother.

title: Kurukshetra
desc: ACP Prithviraj, an honest man, arrests Chief Minister Baburao's son for raping a woman. Consequently, Baburao leaves no stone unturned to get revenge against Prithviraj.

title: Sabdham
desc: A paranormal investigator tackles mysterious university deaths. As evidence mounts, they question their beliefs and confront a possible supernatural threat.
